promptSteps.prompt: Teams with long queues want to see only the jobs at one priority. Please add `--priority <high|normal|low>` to `queuedesk list`, showing only the jobs at that priority among the ones the caller can already see. An unsupported value is a usage error, exit code 1, like the other flags. Everything else about `list` stays as it is, including what it prints when the flag is absent, and the flag has to work together with `--state` and `--all-tenants`. Run `npm test` in the project root to check your work.
